computed.note: Per habit, from its first day to today: the entries (1 yes, 0 no, -1 skipped, or the number), their running total, the share of the target met over the frequency's window, and the score.
computed.parsed: {{map(data.ordered, it.entries == '' ? [] : it.kind == 'measurable' ? map(split(it.entries, ' '), number(it) ?? 0) : map(split(it.entries, ''), it == 'y' ? 1 : it == 's' ? -1 : 0))}}
computed.vals: {{map(data.ordered, slice(concat(computed.parsed[index], map(range(max(0, daysBetween(it.from, state.today) + 1 - length(computed.parsed[index]))), 0)), 0, max(0, daysBetween(it.from, state.today) + 1)))}}
computed.ratio: {{map(data.ordered, scan(computed.prefix[index], {h: acc.h, w: acc.w, need: acc.need, most: acc.most, r: acc.most ? (it - (index >= acc.w ? computed.prefix[acc.h][index - acc.w] : 0) <= acc.need ? 1 : max(0, 2 - (it - (index >= acc.w ? computed.prefix[acc.h][index - acc.w] : 0)) / acc.need)) : min(1, (it - (index >= acc.w ? computed.prefix[acc.h][index - acc.w] : 0)) / acc.need)}, {h: index, w: max(1, it.frequency.days), need: max(0.001, it.kind == 'measurable' ? number(it.target) ?? 1 : it.frequency.times), most: it.kind == 'measurable' && it.targetType == 'atMost'}))}}
computed.score: {{map(data.ordered, scan(computed.ratio[index], {h: acc.h, m: acc.m, s: computed.vals[acc.h][index] == -1 ? acc.s : acc.s * acc.m + it.r * (1 - acc.m)}, {h: index, m: pow(0.5, sqrt(it.kind == 'measurable' ? 1 / max(1, it.frequency.days) : it.frequency.times / max(1, it.frequency.days)) / 13), s: 0}))}}
computed.order: {{state.sort == 'name' ? sort(computed.visible, lower(data.ordered[it].name)) : state.sort == 'color' ? sort(computed.visible, data.ordered[it].color) : state.sort == 'score' ? sort(computed.visible, -computed.now[it]) : state.sort == 'status' ? sort(computed.visible, computed.done[it] ? 1 : 0) : computed.visible}}
computed.keys: {{map(computed.dates, {day: index, week: floor((daysBetween('2000-01-02', it) - state.firstWeekday) / 7), month: slice(it, 0, 7), quarter: slice(it, 0, 4) + floor((number(slice(it, 5, 7)) - 1) / 3), year: slice(it, 0, 4)})}}
computed.scoreLabels: {{map(computed.scoreShown, {a: state.scorePeriod == 'year' ? slice(computed.dates[it], 0, 4) : state.scorePeriod == 'quarter' ? t('quarter', {n: floor((number(slice(computed.dates[it], 5, 7)) - 1) / 3) + 1}) : state.scorePeriod == 'month' ? formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'MMM', 'utc') : formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'd', 'utc'), b: index > 0 && slice(computed.dates[it], 0, state.scorePeriod == 'month' || state.scorePeriod == 'quarter' ? 4 : 7) == slice(computed.dates[computed.scoreShown[index - 1]], 0, state.scorePeriod == 'month' || state.scorePeriod == 'quarter' ? 4 : 7) ? '' : state.scorePeriod == 'month' || state.scorePeriod == 'quarter' ? slice(computed.dates[it], 0, 4) : state.scorePeriod == 'year' ? '' : formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'MMM', 'utc')})}}
computed.historyLabels: {{map(computed.historyShown, {a: state.historyPeriod == 'year' ? slice(computed.dates[it], 0, 4) : state.historyPeriod == 'quarter' ? t('quarter', {n: floor((number(slice(computed.dates[it], 5, 7)) - 1) / 3) + 1}) : state.historyPeriod == 'month' ? formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'MMM', 'utc') : formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'd', 'utc'), b: index > 0 && slice(computed.dates[it], 0, state.historyPeriod == 'month' || state.historyPeriod == 'quarter' ? 4 : 7) == slice(computed.dates[computed.historyShown[index - 1]], 0, state.historyPeriod == 'month' || state.historyPeriod == 'quarter' ? 4 : 7) ? '' : state.historyPeriod == 'month' || state.historyPeriod == 'quarter' ? slice(computed.dates[it], 0, 4) : state.historyPeriod == 'year' ? '' : formatDate(dateMs(computed.dates[it]), 'MMM', 'utc')})}}
computed.scorePath: {{length(computed.scorePts) == 0 ? '' : 'M ' + join(map(computed.scorePts, fixed((index + 0.5) * 1000 / length(computed.scorePts), 1) + ' ' + fixed(100 - it * 100, 1)), ' L ')}}
computed.historyVals: {{map(computed.historyShown, computed.p[it] - (index + length(computed.historyEnds) - length(computed.historyShown) > 0 ? computed.p[computed.historyEnds[index + length(computed.historyEnds) - length(computed.historyShown) - 1]] : 0))}}

computed.goals: {{computed.sel < 0 || computed.h.kind != 'measurable' ? [] : map(['day', 'week', 'month', 'quarter', 'year'], {period: it, start: it == 'day' ? state.today : it == 'week' ? computed.weekStart : it == 'month' ? slice(state.today, 0, 8) + '01' : it == 'quarter' ? slice(state.today, 0, 5) + pad(floor((number(slice(state.today, 5, 7)) - 1) / 3) * 3 + 1, 2, '0') + '-01' : slice(state.today, 0, 5) + '01-01'})}}
computed.goalRows: {{map(computed.goals, {period: it.period, value: computed.p[computed.n - 1] - (computed.n - 1 - daysBetween(it.start, state.today) > 0 ? computed.p[computed.n - 2 - daysBetween(it.start, state.today)] : 0), goal: number(computed.h.target) / max(1, computed.h.frequency.days) * (it.period == 'day' ? 1 : it.period == 'week' ? 7 : it.period == 'year' ? daysBetween(it.start, addMonths(it.start, 12)) : daysBetween(it.start, addMonths(it.start, it.period == 'month' ? 1 : 3)))})}}

computed.freqText: {{computed.sel < 0 ? '' : computed.h.kind == 'measurable' ? t('target', {type: computed.h.targetType, value: computed.h.target, unit: computed.h.unit, per: computed.h.frequency.days == 1 ? 'day' : computed.h.frequency.days == 7 ? 'week' : 'month'}) : computed.h.frequency.days == 1 && computed.h.frequency.times == 1 ? t('freq.daily') : computed.h.frequency.times == 1 && computed.h.frequency.days != 7 && computed.h.frequency.days != 30 ? t('freq.everyN', {n: computed.h.frequency.days}) : t(computed.h.frequency.days == 7 ?
